paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: Comparison between PyramidInfer and full cache baseline with different batch sizes on the LLaMA 2-7B model with input length of 512+256.
model_annotation:
Here's a description of the line plot, following your instructions:

The plot illustrates the relationship between batch size and throughput for two methods. The x-axis is labeled "Batch Size" and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled "Throughput (token/s)" and is also a linear scale ranging from 0 to 2500. A green, solid line, labeled "Full Cache" shows an increasing trend from a value of approximately 500 at a Batch Size of 0 to approximately 1100 at a Batch Size of 60. A pink, dashed line with circular markers, labeled "PyramidInfer," shows a similarly increasing trend from approximately 750 at a Batch Size of 0 to approximately 2500 at a Batch Size of 60.
